definitions.explanation: The act of changing or correcting written content, replacing old text or data with new content.

definitions.gloss: renewal; reissuing (of a document or license)
definitions.explanation: The process of updating or renewing an official document, license, or certificate by replacing it with a new one.

examples.japanese: ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{書|か}き{換|か}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: The data needs to be rewritten.

⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{換|か}えた⟦{疑|うたが}い→疑い：09757_utagai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: An investigation was conducted on suspicion of fraudulently altering the data.

examples.english: I'm going to renew my license.

examples.english: You can renew your driver's license within one month before or after your birthday.

notes:
Noun form of the verb {書|か}き{換|か}える (to rewrite, to renew). Also written as {書|か}き{替|か}え.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{書|か}き{換|か}え: data rewriting/overwriting
- ⟦{免許|めんきょ}→免許：03808_menkyo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{書|か}き{換|か}え: license renewal
- ⟦パスポート→パスポート：00341_pasupooto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{書|か}き{換|か}え: passport renewal
- ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{書|か}き{換|か}え: rewriting of history

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{更新|こうしん}→更新：04765_koushin⟧: renewal, updating (more formal/official; preferred in bureaucratic contexts)
- ⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧: change, modification (broader meaning)
- ⟦{修正|しゅうせい}→修正：03210_shuusei⟧: correction, revision

USAGE:
For license renewal (sense 2), ⟦{更新|こうしん}→更新：04765_koushin⟧ is more common in official contexts, but {書|か}き{換|か}え is widely used in everyday speech.
